instruction: This video has embedded subtitles that I want to save separately. Please extract the subtitles from the video and export them as "captions.srt" in the home directory.

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting subtitles from video.mp4 and saving as captions.srt. Evaluator checks: (1) SRT file exists and contains valid subtitle entries (0.6), (2) video no longer has embedded subtitles after extraction (0.4). Verified gold file has 50 subtitle entries.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Evaluator checks requirement NOT in instruction - instruction says 'extract and export subtitles' but evaluator penalizes if video still has embedded subtitles (0.4 points deducted). The word 'extract' in this context means 'copy/export to separate file', not 'remove from video'

Incorrect semantic interpretation: Standard subtitle extraction tools (VLC, ffmpeg, etc.) typically COPY subtitles to external file without removing them from video. Evaluator assumes extraction must remove subtitles from source video
Scoring breakdown semantically wrong: 60% for SRT validity (actual requirement) + 40% for subtitle removal (NOT a requirement) = incorrect verification
Logic issue in getter: ffmpeg output parsing assumes subtitle stream is always 'Stream #0:2', but stream index can vary (could be #0:1, #0:3, etc.). Should use more robust pattern matching
User completing task correctly (extracting subtitles to captions.srt while video retains embedded subs) would only receive 60% score, which is semantically incorrect
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Remove the 'video no longer has embedded subtitles' check entirely - this is NOT a requirement in the instruction

Change scoring to 100% for SRT file validity: (1) File exists at /home/user/captions.srt (0.3), (2) File is valid SRT format with >0 entries (0.4), (3) Content matches video subtitles semantically (0.3)
Fix ffmpeg parsing logic: Use regex pattern to detect ANY subtitle stream (e.g., 'Stream #\d+:\d+.*Subtitle') instead of hardcoded 'Stream #0:2'
Clarify instruction if subtitle removal IS intended: Change to 'extract subtitles from the video, export as captions.srt, and remove embedded subtitles from the video file'
